V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Lawn area is bounded by the building on the north, a dense row of shrubs on the west, and a row of shrubs on the south, creating a clearly defined outdoor room.

V-FOCAL.evidence: No specimen tree, water feature, fire pit, or pergola is present. The plan shows only a lawn, a terrace, and scattered shrubs/small trees with no single dominant element.

V-AXIS.evidence: A tan path runs along the bottom edge and up the left side, connecting the lawn area to the terrace and the house door (red diamond).

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Multiple Punicas repeated along the right and bottom edges, a mass of shrubs along the left wall, and a drift of ground cover in the bottom right corner.

V-LAYERING.evidence: Left side shows a vertical stack of canopy/small trees over a row of shrubs and ground cover clusters. Bottom edge shows a similar layered sequence of trees, shrubs, and perennials. Two distinct planting zones with clear vertical layering are visible.

V-ROOMS.evidence: A large lawn area, a paved terrace with a table and seat adjacent to the house, and a tan paved path along the street side create distinct zones with different floor surfaces and uses.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear structure: building anchors one side, lawn forms a central room, planting masses define edges, terrace creates a distinct zone, and walls enclose the space.
